subject: Capstone community engagement project — request for extra trial credits
messages:
From: Prof. Anya Reed <anya.reed@harbor.edu>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional/more credits for community capstone (IRB delay)

Hi Rohan,

I'm writing from Harbor University's Community Data Lab — our senior capstone cohort had been approved for a small Redwood trial earlier this term, which has been incredibly helpful. Unfortunately the IRB approval for the community-engagement arm was delayed by six weeks, and several student groups were unable to start their hands-on runs within the original trial window.

We have:
- 12 student groups (NLP / summarization + entity anonymization use cases)
- a faculty-supervised pilot timeline that now runs through end of July

Could Redwood provide a one-time extension or supplemental credits to let those teams finish their experiments? We can provide the IRB communications (attached) and a short capstone deliverable template so usage is scoped. We are a nonprofit public university; students and the community partner would benefit from the extra run time.

Desired ask:
1) 200k token credit supplement or a two-week trial extension (whichever is simpler)
2) Confirmation of data retention handling for student-submitted test data (anonymization assurances)

I've attached the project proposal and the IRB delay note. Happy to hop on a short call if useful.

Thanks,
Prof. Anya Reed
Director, Community Data Lab
Harbor University
anya.reed@harbor.edu

---
Attachment: harbor-capstone-proposal.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: irb-delay-note.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: additional/more credits for community capstone (IRB delay)

Hi Anya —

Thanks for the clear note and for sending the attachments. Really glad the trial helped the students.

I'll route this to the academic partnerships and credits team for a quick review. A couple quick clarifying Qs that will help with approvals:
- Are the student projects using non-sensitive community data or synthetic/anonymized extracts?
- Do you expect incremental usage to be concentrated in model fine-tuning runs or interactive generation/ops?

Marissa — looping you in for partnership context and to see if we can do a discretionary supplement for Harbor's capstone (public university nonprofit).
Laura — for the credits/credits-ops scope: if we authorize, is it easier to provision a 200k token top-up or to extend the trial window for an account? Any constraints from renewal/process side?

Happy to join a quick call tomorrow afternoon if that helps move faster.

Cheers,
Rohan Mehta
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Prof. Anya Reed <anya.reed@harbor.edu>, Samira Ortega <samira.ortega@harbor.edu>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: additional/more credits for community capstone (IRB delay)

Forwarding Harbor's ask with a short recommendation.

Summary: Harbor University — public, long-term relationship potential (class pipeline + research pilots). IRB delay is legitimate; students need runway. Recommend a targeted supplement: 175k token credit top-up tied to the existing trial project ID OR a time-limited two-week extension scoped to the attached proposal. Prefer token top-up for simpler tracking.

Conditions I suggest:
- Credits granted for project-id: harbor-capstone-2027 (we'll attach to the trial account)
- Use limited to student-run experiments and not for production services
- Data handling note: require that student-submitted data is anonymized, and we document that in a short MOU (drafted by Marissa)

Laura — can you provision a 175k credit (or 200k if ops prefers round number) and mark it as nonprofit education? Also, what's the internal approval path if we need to exceed 200k?

Anya / Samira — if you can confirm the anonymization approach (one-line), we can try to complete this this week.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Director, Academic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Thanks for the context. Ops can provision education/top-up credits. We can either:

Option A — Token top-up: 175,000 tokens added to Harbor trial account ID harbor-capstone-2027. Expires 2027-08-01. (Preferred — easiest to audit.)
